title: Gateway native_sim build broken on main: Kconfig WIFI recursive-dependency aborts configure
description: Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-dzyt (uwip.3 validation, worker8/heft 2026-09-09). Reproduced on BOTH worker8 branch AND the pristine lichen-workspace main checkout (8d7776e2fc), so pre-existing and unrelated to dzyt: cmake configure of lichen/apps/gateway for native_sim/native/64 aborts at kconfig.cmake:396 'Aborting due to Kconfig warnings' with a recursive-dependency warning: '...depends again on WIFI (defined at boards/shields/adafruit_winc1500/Kconfig.defconfig:8, drivers/wifi/Kconfig:6)' via POSIX select-related deps (WIFI_NM_WPA_SUPPLICANT || NXP_WIFI_SIGMA_AGENT...). The historical working build (build-gw-zt3c74-base) used module set lichen+tinycrypt; same recipe now fails -> drift is in tree or zephyr 4.1.0 pin, not in module plumbing. Blocks native_sim validation of the gateway app and of lora_sim.c changes. Repro: cd <checkout> && cmake -B b -S lichen/apps/gateway -GNinja -DBOARD=native_sim/native/64 -DZEPHYR_MODULES='<checkout>/lichen;<modules>/crypto/tinycrypt' with ZEPHYR_BASE + SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set.
close_reason: Fixed the named recursion plus everything it masked except one follow-up root cause. Changes: (1) apps/gateway/Kconfig LICHEN_GATEWAY_PREFIX_DELEGATION 'select WIFI' -> 'depends on WIFI' (breaks the 4.1 recursion WIFI->NET_IPV6->NET_CONFIG_AUTO_INIT->USBD_CDC_ECM_CLASS->NET_L2_ETHERNET->WIFI_AIROC->WIFI; heltec_v3/t_deck set CONFIG_WIFI=y in board conf so behavior preserved); (2) prj.conf: removed CONFIG_NET_ROUTE/CONFIG_NET_ROUTING (promptless in 4.1, assignments fatal; NET_ROUTE stays y via LICHEN_RPL select + NET_IPV6_NBR_CACHE default); (3) coap/Kconfig LICHEN_COAP_CONFIG: select LICHEN_COAP_KEYS made conditional on LICHEN_SLIP_TRANSPORT && ZCBOR (its genuine deps per bd a2a2); (4) rpl/Kconfig LICHEN_CCP_TDMA: selects of LICHEN_TDMA/LICHEN_CCP_TIME_SYNC made conditional on LICHEN_LINK_CCP16_LOAD_BALANCING. Verified on heft (zephyr 4.1.0 tree): recursive count 0; full west build -b native_sim/native/64 lichen/apps/gateway now passes symbol resolution with EXACTLY ONE remaining warning - 'Deprecated symbol TINYCRYPT is enabled' (4.1 tinycrypt deprecation, tree-wide, blocks configure; no suppress knob exists in 4.1). That migration is filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-at2y (P1) - the native_sim gateway target stays blocked until it lands. 3x codereview: correctness+security delegated to kimi-k3 (both PASS, zero findings); edge pass self-run (reviewer timed out 2x) - all boards verified (PREFIX_DELEGATION boards all have WIFI=y; only gateway prj.conf uses LICHEN_COAP_CONFIG; WiFi boards have EPOCH_PERSIST=y so TDMA selects still fire there).
